name: chess-dundun
description: 棋墩墩 — 掀棋/打棋摞 的规则引擎与人机对战

scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:layout && npm run test:style && npm run test:net && npm run test:link && npm run test:discover && npm run test:local && npm run test:ui && npm run test:qr && npm run test:desktop
scripts.test:net: node --experimental-strip-types src/test/net.table.test.ts; s=$?; node --experimental-strip-types src/test/net.host.test.ts; t=$?; node --experimental-strip-types src/test/net.wire.test.ts; u=$?; exit $((s+t+u))
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm run test
scripts.icon: sed 's/rx="112"/rx="0"/' public/icon.svg > /tmp/icon-square.svg && qlmanage -t -s 512 -o /tmp /tmp/icon-square.svg >/dev/null 2>&1 && command mv -f /tmp/icon-square.svg.png public/icon-512.png && sips -Z 180 public/icon-512.png --out public/apple-touch-icon.png >/dev/null && sips -Z 32 public/icon-512.png --out public/icon-32.png >/dev/null && echo 已按 public/icon.svg 重画 icon-512 / apple-touch-icon / icon-32
scripts.apk:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) ./gradlew assembleDebug
